propositions: Flaky tests are bugs to root-cause with /rebar-debug, not retried until passing, because a nondeterministic pipeline slows development, wastes tokens, and erodes CI as a regression oracle.

AGENTS.md and CONTRIBUTING.md currently offer recheck as a remedy for failures that 'look transient/flaky' without distinguishing environmental faults from test nondeterminism, creating a contradiction with the debug-not-retry rule.

The guidance must be consolidated in AGENTS.md as the authoritative statement, narrowing recheck to provably environmental faults (TLS cert flakes, missing dispatch, runner outages) with stated reasoning in the comment.
CONTRIBUTING.md section 6 must split the two cases explicitly: environmental faults stay recheckable with reasoning; nondeterministic tests link to the AGENTS.md rule instead of suggesting retry.
A new unit test must assert both that the rule and its rationale are present in AGENTS.md and that the old retry-until-green licence is absent from both files.
